file:cw.py.name: cw.py
file:cw.py.summary: Single-file CLI that drives the interactive `claude` TUI through tmux and stores full-fidelity replies in SQLite. Entry point `main()` dispatches `ask`/`history`/`stop` subcommands; `ask()` acquires a per-session flock, calls `ensure_session()` to launch `claude --permission-mode <mode>` in a detached tmux pane, `send_text()` to bracketed-paste the prompt plus an INSTRUCTION to Write a verbatim answer to a `.cw/<turn-id>.md` scratch file, and `run_turn()` to poll for that file (falling back to lossy `scrape_reply()` on hang/dialog/timeout). Screen-state helpers `has_spinner`, `looks_blocked`, `at_idle_prompt` parse tmux captures; `init_db()` creates/migrates the `responses` table. Standard library only; never uses `claude -p`.

file:test_cw.py.name: test_cw.py
file:test_cw.py.summary: Plain assert-based test script (no test framework) exercising cw's pure screen-parsing helpers against fixture captures (DONE, WORKING, TRUST, PERMISSION). Validates `has_spinner`, `looks_blocked`, `at_idle_prompt`, and `scrape_reply`. Run directly with `python3 test_cw.py`; no live claude needed.

file:README.md.name: README.md
file:README.md.summary: End-user documentation: rationale (subscription vs Agent SDK credit billing), requirements (claude, tmux, python3), install as a single file, usage of ask/history/stop, the ask flags table, a how-it-works walkthrough, limitations, and roadmap. MIT licensed.

file:CLAUDE.md.name: CLAUDE.md
file:CLAUDE.md.summary: Guidance for Claude Code working in this repo. Documents the two design rationales (subscription billing -> never `claude -p`; file side channel -> avoid lossy TUI scraping), an ASCII architecture diagram of the ask/run_turn poll loop, exact commands, conventions (stdlib-only, single file, tuning constants, multi-place DB-column edits), and forbidden patterns.

file:.gitignore.name: .gitignore
file:.gitignore.summary: Ignores the generated SQLite DB (cw.sqlite), the per-turn scratch dir (.cw/), and Python bytecode (__pycache__/, *.pyc).

dir:..name: claude-wrapper
dir:..summary: `cw`: a single-file Python tool that scripts the interactive `claude` TUI via tmux so usage bills against the Claude subscription instead of the Agent SDK credit pool. `cw.py` holds all logic (tmux orchestration, file side-channel capture, SQLite storage); `test_cw.py` covers the pure screen-parsing helpers. `README.md` is end-user docs and `CLAUDE.md` is agent guidance. No build system or third-party dependencies — standard library only.
